race.comment: CAPTURE ME (8) opened this prep with a couple of minor placings then dominated a Class 1 field over 1150m at the Illawarra Grange circuit last start. Has proven himself in town and on the back of that impressive effort last time this looks well within reach. UNSTOPABULL (10) missed the kick as always then closed with purpose to get up for third last time out over 1200m at this track. His poor barriers manners make life hard but he could win one of these sometime soon. CONDONE (5) is a lightly raced four-year-old who had to pull out all stops to get the cash over 1200m at Wyong recently. Draws a much better gate this time and gets a couple of kilos off so this looks a suitable assignment. RIVENDELL (3) resumes. Opened last prep with comfortable win at Kembla. Easily won a recent trial so he looks up for this. Honest gelding MONTE VEEBEE (2) is back after a 20-week spell. Goes well when fresh and a recent trial win suggests he is forward in his preparation.
